why: B: on every abstract connected Hausdorff ℝⁿ-manifold with any smooth Mathlib RiemannianBundle metric and any Levi-Civita connection, Milnor-complete (ρ-Cauchy sequences converge), for every p and v ∈ T_pM ≅ ℝⁿ (v = 0 included): exp_p(v) is conjugate to p along γ_v(t) = exp_p(tv) (blind IsConj: nonzero Jacobi field on [0,1] vanishing at 0 and 1) iff exp_p : ℝⁿ → M is critical at v (non-injective mfderiv). A (universes 0): for slice submanifolds N ⊆ V with the induced metric only, and v in the open domain expDomAt of exp_q (no completeness): the fields W_X are Jacobi fields, X ↦ W_X is injective, the conjugate space is the image of ker d(exp_q)_v, multiplicity = dim ker d(exp_q)_v, and Theorem 18.1. A ⇒ B fails genuinely (abstract manifolds are not given embedded; no abstract exp/Jacobi theory in the project); B ⇒ A fails genuinely (setting; A drops completeness and adds the multiplicity statement). On embedded manifolds A ⇒ B_emb and B_emb ⇒ Theorem 18.1 for complete connected N are proved.
overlap: No A_to_B/B_to_A. For the embedded theorem B_emb_to_A_cplt: 403 shared project theorems — the exp/geodesic-flow ODE infrastructure (Flow.*, LocalSpray.*, IsBddLipschitz.*, raysGoodE_of_isGeodesicOn, exists_contDiffOn_exp, contDiffOn_expAt, isSmoothCurveIn_ray: smoothness of exp_p, needed to translate B's mfderiv into dExpAt), Hopf–Rinow (hopf_rinow, riemDist_ne_top) for the completeness dictionary, slice-chart/tangent-projection lemmas and Jacobi-field basics from the Bridge and the Jacobi dictionary. None of the Theorem 18.1 argument (expJacobi, isJacobiField_expJacobi, covAlong_expJacobi_zero, eq_expJacobi, conjSpace_eq_map_ker, jacEval_bijective for W_X) is shared.
